task_description: Create a comprehensive, publication-ready review article in LaTeX about Graph Neural Networks for Earthquake Early Warning Systems, targeting Earth-Science Reviews (Elsevier). Minimum 30 pages, 100+ references, expert-level academic writing from the perspective of a professor in AI and seismology.

verification.summary: PDF compiles successfully to 46 pages (requirement: 30+). 122 BibTeX entries all cited. 6 TikZ figures, 5 tables, 12 major sections. Abstract trimmed to ~250 words. All review issues addressed: unverifiable references replaced, all bib entries cited, placeholders fixed, BibTeX formatting corrected, table claims qualified with citations, speculative conclusion claims grounded with parenthetical citations.
